_comment: Canonical document descriptor template (document/<name>.json). Documents exactly what the reflexive layer reads from the brique section when resolving a document via read.document.

brique._comment: Required. The reflexive layer reads this section to resolve the document target. Exactly one of 'ref' or 'file' must be present.
brique._ref_note: Use when the document lives at an external URI (HTTP, S3, etc.). When non-empty, the engine returns kind='ref' and the ref value — it never fetches the content itself. Mutually exclusive with 'file': if ref is non-empty, file is ignored.
brique._file_note: Use when the document content is a local file. Must be a relative path that stays under the context directory. Accepted forms: 'document/my_file.md' (explicit prefix) or 'my_file.md' (the engine prepends 'document/' automatically). Must not start with '/' or contain '../'. The referenced file must exist on disk — the engine stat-checks it at resolution time. Mutually exclusive with 'ref': only set one.

objective._comment: Optional. Projected by the reflexive meaning layer.
objective.name: <document_name>
objective._name_note: Conventionally matches the descriptor filename without .json.
objective.description: One sentence describing what this document contains.

functional._comment: Opaque to the engine. Describe content type and source for tooling and wrappers.
functional._source_kind_note: Informational. 'local' when file is set; 'ref' when ref is set.

_subjective_note: Optional. Free-form space for subjective categorization. Add any key-value pairs meaningful to you or your team — tags, priority, notes, author opinions. The engine ignores this section entirely.
